message.content: {"needs_revision": false, "reasoning": "The pipeline only reads training features/labels during train and loads persisted preprocessing, encoders, and fold models without refitting at predict, so there is no test-label leakage. The evaluation metric is accuracy and the threshold is tuned on OOF training predictions, which is a legitimate internal holdout, and predictions come from the early-stopping best checkpoints of the actual models. Inference writes row_id plus the decoded original label in input order, satisfying the contract; the unsupervised imputation fit on all training data does not leak test labels or compromise final predictions."}
